summary: Covers manufacturers of packaged and processed foods. Disclosures address energy, water, food safety, health and nutrition, product labelling and marketing, packaging lifecycle, and the environmental and social impacts of ingredient supply chains and sourcing.

questions.text: What are (1) the total energy consumed, (2) the percentage of that energy that is grid electricity and (3) the percentage that is renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total energy consumed in GJ, (2) the percentage supplied as grid electricity and (3) the percentage that is renewable. Include self-generated and purchased renewable energy where applicable.

questions.text: What are (1) the total water withdrawn and (2) the total water consumed, and what percentage of each is in regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress?
questions.hint: Unit: Thousand cubic metres (m³), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total water withdrawn and (2) total water consumed in thousand m3, and the percentage of each located in regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress.

questions.text: How many incidents of non-compliance with water quality permits, standards and regulations did your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of incidents of non-compliance associated with water quality permits, standards and regulations in the reporting period.

questions.text: What water management risks does your organisation face, and what strategies and practices do you use to mitigate them?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the main water management risks and the strategies and practices used to mitigate them, including any targets and performance against them.

questions.text: What were your Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) audit (1) non-conformance rates and (2) associated corrective action rates for (a) major and (b) minor non-conformances?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report the rates separately for (1) non-conformances and (2) associated corrective actions, split into (a) major and (b) minor non-conformances, across GFSI audits.

questions.text: What percentage of the ingredients you source, by cost, comes from Tier 1 supplier facilities certified to a Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) recognised food safety certification programme?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by cost · Report the percentage, by cost, of ingredients sourced from Tier 1 supplier facilities certified to a GFSI-recognised programme.

questions.text: What are (1) the total number of notices of food safety violation you received and (2) the percentage corrected?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) the total number of food safety violation notices received and (2) the percentage that were corrected.

questions.text: How many food product recalls did you issue, and what was the total amount of food product recalled?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Metric tonnes (t) · Report (1) the number of recalls issued and (2) the total amount of food product recalled in metric tonnes.

questions.text: What revenue does your organisation earn from products labelled or marketed to promote health and nutrition attributes?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report revenue from products labelled or marketed to promote health and nutrition attributes, in your presentation currency.

questions.text: How does your organisation identify and manage products and ingredients related to nutritional and health concerns among consumers?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the process to identify and manage products and ingredients of nutritional or health concern, including reformulation, labelling and portfolio decisions.

questions.text: What percentage of your advertising impressions were (1) made on children and (2) made on children promoting products that meet dietary guidelines?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report (1) the percentage of advertising impressions made on children and (2) the percentage of those that promote products meeting dietary guidelines. State the guidelines and age threshold used.

questions.text: What revenue does your organisation earn from products labelled as (1) containing genetically modified organisms (GMOs) and (2) non-GMO?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report (1) revenue from products labelled as containing GMOs and (2) revenue from products labelled non-GMO, each in your presentation currency.

questions.text: How many incidents of non-compliance with industry or regulatory labelling or marketing codes did your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of incidents of non-compliance with industry or regulatory labelling or marketing codes in the reporting period.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with labelling or marketing practices?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses (fines, settlements, damages) from legal proceedings related to labelling or marketing practices, in your presentation currency.

questions.text: What are (1) the total weight of your packaging, (2) the percentage made from recycled or renewable materials and (3) the percentage that is recyclable, reusable or compostable?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total packaging weight in metric tonnes, (2) the percentage made from recycled or renewable materials and (3) the percentage that is recyclable, reusable or compostable.

questions.text: What strategies does your organisation use to reduce the environmental impact of its packaging throughout its lifecycle?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe strategies to reduce packaging impacts across the lifecycle, such as material reduction, redesign, recycled content, and end-of-life recovery, with any targets.

disclosures.title: Environmental & Social Impacts of Ingredient Supply Chain

questions.text: What percentage of the food ingredients you source, by cost, is certified to third-party environmental or social standards, and what is the percentage for each standard?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by cost · Report the total percentage of ingredients sourced, by cost, with third-party environmental or social certification, and the percentage for each standard.

questions.text: What were your suppliers' social and environmental responsibility audit (1) non-conformance rate and (2) associated corrective action rate for (a) major and (b) minor non-conformances?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report (1) the non-conformance rate and (2) the associated corrective action rate from supplier social and environmental audits, each split into (a) major and (b) minor non-conformances.

questions.text: What percentage of your food ingredients, by cost, is sourced from regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by cost · Report the percentage of food ingredients, by cost, (by cost or as specified) sourced from regions with High or Extremely High Baseline Water Stress.

questions.text: What are your priority food ingredients, and what sourcing risks related to environmental and social considerations do they present?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · List the priority food ingredients and discuss the environmental and social sourcing risks for each, and how you manage them.

questions.text: What was the weight of the products you sold?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report the weight of products sold in metric tonnes.

questions.text: How many production facilities does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of production facilities.
